hook: Abhishek Sharma's two statistical twins are both in this series.
lines: Finn Allen and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, each 13 points away.
First, we rank Abhishek against 230 batters on 23 features: when he bats, how he scores, and the shots he plays.
Then we measure how far every batter sits from him.
He sits at the edge of the map, and the closest two play in this series.
Allen even adds the same value: 55.8 runs above par per 100 balls, to Abhishek's 55.3.
